results.name: OrderIso.finsetSetFinite
results.source_text:
/-- `Finset α` is order isomorphic to the type of finite sets in `α`. -/
@[simps] noncomputable def OrderIso.finsetSetFinite : Finset α ≃o {s : Set α // s.Finite} where
  toFun s := ⟨s, s.finite_toSet⟩
  invFun s := s.2.toFinset
  left_inv _ := by simp
  right_inv _ := by simp
  map_rel_iff' := .rfl
results.docstring: `Finset α` is order isomorphic to the type of finite sets in `α`.

results.name: Set.Finite
results.source_text:
/-- A set is finite if the corresponding `Subtype` is finite,
i.e., if there exists a natural `n : ℕ` and an equivalence `s ≃ Fin n`. -/
protected def Finite (s : Set α) : Prop := Finite s
results.docstring:
A set is finite if the corresponding `Subtype` is finite,
i.e., if there exists a natural `n : ℕ` and an equivalence `s ≃ Fin n`.

results.name: List.minimum
results.source_text:
/-- `minimum l` returns a `WithTop α`, the smallest element of `l` for nonempty lists, and `⊤` for
`[]` -/
def minimum (l : List α) : WithTop α :=
  argmin id l
results.docstring:
`minimum l` returns a `WithTop α`, the smallest element of `l` for nonempty lists, and `⊤` for
`[]`

results.name: Finset.Colex.instOrderBot

instance instOrderBot : OrderBot (Colex (Finset α)) where
  bot := toColex ∅
  bot_le s a ha := by cases ha

results.name: Minimal.not_lt

@[to_dual not_gt]
theorem Minimal.not_lt (h : Minimal P x) (hy : P y) : ¬(y < x) :=
  fun hlt ↦ h.not_prop_of_lt hlt hy

results.name: Minimal
results.source_text:
/-- `Minimal P x` means that `x` is a minimal element satisfying `P`. -/
@[to_dual /-- `Maximal P x` means that `x` is a maximal element satisfying `P`. -/]
def Minimal (P : α → Prop) (x : α) : Prop := P x ∧ ∀ ⦃y⦄, P y → y ≤ x → x ≤ y
results.docstring: `Minimal P x` means that `x` is a minimal element satisfying `P`.

results.name: ArchimedeanClass.FiniteElement
results.source_text:
/-- The valuation subring of elements in non-negative Archimedean classes, i.e. elements bounded by
some natural number. -/
def FiniteElement : Type _ :=
  (addValuation K).toValuation.valuationSubring
deriving CommRing, IsDomain, ValuationRing, LinearOrder, IsStrictOrderedRing
results.docstring:
The valuation subring of elements in non-negative Archimedean classes, i.e. elements bounded by
some natural number.
